body.holds_when: The divergence stratum is empty or too small, making stratified analysis infeasible.
body.relation_hint: The empty-divergence-stratum counterexample motivates the need for a corrupted-checklist control, because if divergence cannot be observed, the only single-evidence contrast is between real and corrupted checklist.
body.weakens_when: The divergence stratum is sufficiently populated to support stratified analysis without a control.
